ModMetaData.name: Better_InfiniteReactor
ModMetaData.author: Aquin
ModMetaData.description:
这个mod让无限反应釜更加有用了，可以切换为生产模式和发电模式以及可以在设置里调整他们的数值。 生产模式和发电模式都可以更改生产的物品，可选择的为：化合燃料和中性胺。
This mod makes the infinite reactor more versatile by allowing it to switch between production and power modes, as well as adjusting the produced items. In production mode, it can produce chemfuel or neutroamine, while in power mode, it can generate power.
